title: V1 Acceptance LOW R2 — MoneyToman boundary regression
description: Stage C Test 1 restart after Phase 0 became valid. This is a fresh legitimate bounded regression/safety improvement for MoneyToman safe-integer boundaries. It does not reuse PR #218 artifact-bound evidence and does not mutate production runtime code.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C Test 1 R2 must remain deterministically LOW. PR #218 and its artifact-bound evidence are historical only and MUST NOT be reused. This fresh artifact requires exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK plus provider-bound Verification and protected merge/post-merge evidence.

acceptance_criteria.description: MoneyToman accepts exactly Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER without precision loss.
Unsafe numeric inputs, fractional values and negative amounts fail closed.
Addition and integer multiplication cannot overflow the JavaScript safe-integer ceiling, and subtraction cannot cross below zero.
The task changes exactly the three authorized paths and contains no production runtime, workflow, dependency, database, API, roadmap or product-design mutation.
Deterministic classification remains LOW with Human Gate not required; classification is not forced or downgraded.
Exact-head verify, Phase A and merge-policy must pass before protected workflow_dispatch merge, followed by exact-SHA postmerge verification before Test 1 completion is claimed.
